deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a description of the tumour's physical position relative to the uterus that the lecturer did not explicitly state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus,

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes the term 'circumspect' to 'circumscribed'. Although it is likely what the lecturer meant, substituting a different term that changes the literal wording to make the statement complete/clear is a forbidden distortion.

considerations.reason: The rewrite turns this plural into 'which is quite rare' referring to 'a malignant case'. This preserves the meaning correctly.

considerations.sourcePassage: So that is what invasion would look like,
considerations.reason: This is a repetition of the preceding sentence ('So you can see this is what the invasion looks like') and is an allowed omission.
The word 'necessarily' was dropped from 'difficult to necessarily find', which is an allowed change that removes awkward phrasing without altering the core meaning.
